A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Pindra system/Legends|Pindra system]] between the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Willham Burke]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] Admiral [[Ledre Okins]]. Burke tricked Okins into diverting key elements of his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to the Pindra system, where Burke destroyed them in a [[grav trap]] amid the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Pindra system asteroids|asteroids]].<ref name="Warfare" />
